subject: Architectural sync: load-test & token throughput targets
messages:
From: Asha Verma <asha@acmecloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Architectural sync: load-test & token throughput targets

Hi Priyom / Vivek —

Thanks again for the quick responses on the PoC scope. We’ve been running internal sims and would like to schedule a 60–90 minute architecture deep-dive focused on performance and latency verification before the PoC kickoff. High level ask: align on load-test plan, token/sec targets, and what we’ll measure during the run (p50/p95 latencies, tail behavior, KV cache warm/cold effects).

A few specifics from our side:
- Desired sustained peak: ~200–300k tokens/sec (we can provide traffic shape)
- Target p95 SLO: <350ms for generation requests
- Goal: determine whether we should use dedicated capacity or host on Redwood shared for initial tests

Would folks from Redwood infra + perf be able to meet Wed or Thu this week? Suggested slots (PT):
- Wed May 5: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu May 6: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30

I’ve attached a quick traffic snapshot and the latest SLA doc. Please let me know who from your side should be in the room and whether you want any pre-reads.

Attachments: acme-prod-traffic-snapshot.csv, SLA_requirement_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Asha Verma
Head of Platform Reliability, Acme Cloud
asha@acmecloud.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Asha Verma <asha@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architectural sync: load-test & token throughput targets

Hi Asha —

Appreciate the detail — this is exactly the right ask. We should plan for a 75-minute technical deep-dive (45–60m discussion + 15–30m booking for next steps and runbook alignment).

People I’m adding: Marissa (perf lead) to drive the load-test plan, Laura (console/observability) to confirm tracing and SLI hooks, and Vivek for routing/fallback policy discussion.

I can do Wed May 5 at 10:00–11:15 PT. If that works for you I’ll send the calendar invite.

Pre-reads I’ll share before the meeting:
- Redwood loadtest runbook (draft) — redwood-loadtest-runbook-draft.md (attached)
- brief on batching/kv-cache behavior and recommended quantization profiles

Open questions for your team before the sync:
- Can you confirm the token distribution by endpoint (e.g., 60% single-turn generation, 40% multi-turn chat)?
- Any strict memory/timeout constraints on the client side we should know about?
- Is the SLA p95 above for tail-of-generation only, or end-to-end including pre/post processing?

If Wed 10:00 PT works, I’ll lock it and drop the runbook link.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-loadtest-runbook-draft.md

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Priyom / Asha —

I can make Wed 10:00 PT. Quick notes from perf:
- We’ll want both sustained and spike profiles (5–15 minute spikes at 1.5–2x sustained)
- Plan to test cold vs warm KV cache and one run with continuous KV-warm traffic
- Please share expected concurrency per route and average sequence length so we can estimate KV cache hit rate

I’m attaching a token-cost estimate workbook so we can ballpark cost impact based on run duration.

See you Wednesday.

–Marissa

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 9:40 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com> wrote:
> I can do Wed May 5 at 10:00–11:15 PT. If that works for you I’ll send the calendar invite.

That works for us — Wed 5/5 10:00–11:15 PT is confirmed.

To clarify traffic shape:
- 70% single-turn generation requests (avg sequence length ~64 tokens)
- 30% multi-turn (avg 3 turns, ~120 tokens total)
- Conservative peak target we want to validate: sustain 250k tokens/sec; burst to 400k for 10 minutes acceptable for stress testing
- p50 target: <120ms, p95 target: <350ms (generation-only time).

We’ll also share a short list of representative request payloads before the meeting.

Thanks all — looking forward.

Regards,
Asha

Great — Wed 5/5 10:00–11:15 PT confirmed on my calendar. Meeting invite & agenda sent separately.

Proposed agenda (will post to the calendar invite):
1) 10m — Introductions & objectives (Priyom/Asha)
2) 25m — Traffic shape, targets, and PoC acceptance criteria (Asha/Acme)
3) 25m — Redwood load-test plan: batching, KV cache, quantization profile, and fallback policies (Marissa/Vivek)
4) 15m — Observability and SLI hooks & post-test artifacts (Laura)
5) 10m — Next steps / rollouts / decision criteria for Dedicated vs Hosted

Attachments going into the invite: meeting-ops-checklist.pdf, redwood-loadtest-runbook-draft.md, token-cost-estimate.xlsx

Action items before the sync:
- Asha: upload representative request payloads and a short doc describing endpoint distribution to the shared Drive link (thanks).
- Marissa: sketch the initial run matrix (sustained / spike / cold-warm) and share by EOD Tue.
- Laura: confirm SLI names and whether we should instrument an extra trace/span for prefix caching.

If anything changes I’ll update the invite. See you Wednesday.

—Priyom
